name: Kidney Burnt Offering Of The
overview: The Kidney Burnt Offering, as described in Leviticus 4 and 7, involves the removal and burning of the two kidneys along with the fat surrounding them and the caul above the liver. This portion, taken from peace and trespass offerings, is to be burned by the priest upon the altar as a fire offering to the LORD. These instructions emphasize the importance of specific sacrificial elements dedicated wholly to God, symbolizing atonement and consecration through the priestly ministry.
